featured_reviews.name: Erik de Maaker
featured_reviews.review_text: Mahavir Sweet and Farsan has an amazing variety of tasty  savory, crunchy, or steamed snacks, many of which are freshly made on a daily or even more than daily basis. One of these is their khandvi (thin, rolled savory chickpea flour cakes), which is simply out of this world. The shop also offers an enormous variety of packaged snacks (such as gathiya, rotla, bhakari), many of which are not easily found in mainstream supermarkets. I found the staff of their Ghatkoper shop to be super helpful, trying to understand the buying instructions I had received from my partner, and considering what could and what would probably not survive the intercontinental flight which I was about to take. Prices are reasonable, and the shop I visited is conveniently located at a few minutes walk from the Ghatkoper metro station (use gate 1A).

featured_reviews.name: Samir Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: JJ Jalebi at LBS Road Kurla makes Kurla a Complete Hub For Foodies.The food is good and made fresh.Overall good dining experience. Faced some difficulties related to parking, everything was good. The ambiance is nice and staff is very friendly. I would say it was kids friendly too. I found the menu to be affordable.Quantity was also very much!!

featured_reviews.name: Sabir Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited JJ restaurant and decided to try their Burmese soup based on the positive words of mouth from friends, it was a delightful experience and also try Nan Chicken it was also delicious. The restaurant atmosphere was Good!!
They have good variety in Tawa items. Will visit again to try different cuisine.

featured_reviews.name: Deepak Bagade
featured_reviews.review_text:
J J Jalebi is an ultimate one stop shop for Meat Lover. Every dish was so yummy and delicious. Each dish was different by its looks as well as by taste. From my perspective best was Chicken in green Sauce and Chicken in Hot garlic - though rest all dishes were equally good.
Starters were well cooked - crispy from outside and soft from inside. Ambience was good, their hospitality and service was amazing, after definite interval use to visit and ask for additional order. We were so full with their starters only that we didn't had a chance to taste some of their signature sweet dishes
They also gave omlette and french fries on the house for our kids.
We appreciated the owner and the staff for providing such a wonderful experience.
We definitely visit this place again

featured_reviews.name: Burhan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Just had J.J Jalebi's gulab jamun with an amazing fly garish 💫

featured_reviews.name: mohammed ansari
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently purchased a jalebi parcel from your Kurla shop and were excited to enjoy it with our family. However, upon arrival home, we noticed that the rabri had a very unpleasant smell, and the jalebi was quite hard, making it difficult to eat.

Unfortunately, we had to make the tough decision to throw away the jalebi. I wanted to bring this to your attention, as we have always enjoyed your products in the past and hope this was just an isolated incident.

featured_reviews.name: Mohammed Wazid Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Today, I went to buy Jalebi at this shop ( J.J Jalebi Kurla , LBS Road) The Jalebi appeared to be NOT fresh, hence I asked about it. The owner sitting on the counter responded to me in rude and sarcastic tone stating " haan basi (stale) hai , kal ki hai. I just handed over the Jalebi back to them and left surprised and dissappointed. I am not sure about the taste and quality of the sweets they sell, so I can't comment on that aspect. I just thought of sharing my today's experience with you all. Thanks.
